audit.why: Lane is Naafiri-favored at every stage (50.83% WR, packet chart Naafiri x7): immobile mage whose only self-peel is landing E on a sphere. Content layer states this correctly; full layer's chart carried 'Skill'/'Syndra' rows that disagreed with the content layer.
Spikes: Naafiri 3-5 (W-E all-in), 6 (R closes spacing), first item; late stays close but Naafiri-favored if E is dodged. spikes[0..3] all present and kit-accurate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer calls Naafiri's champion dash 'W' with a 'lock-on' — per the kit W is the untargetable pack empower and the lock-on dash is R. Syndra widely misgendered (13 lint hits). E-into-R execute threat and her true-damage W (resists don't answer it) were unstated in the full layer.
audit.why: Kit authority: Syndra E 15s flat is her only hard CC; W true damage at max stacks; R executes when upgraded. Naafiri W = untargetability.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed, dive references moved to R, execute/true-damage threat added to breakdown.late.
E 15s flat, W 12s rank 1, Naafiri E 11s added.
